If you're reading this, you already know how the deal works.

We need 5 specific vehicles and we need them in working condition. No junk, no excuses.

The models are as follows:

1. '67 Shelby GT500 Eleanor
2. '82 Porsche 911 Turbo
3. '81 DeLorean DMC-12 BTTF
4. '92 Nissan Skyline GT-R
5. '90 BMW E30 Cabrio

You have a limited window. We won't repeat ourselves.

Drop-off point:
The Louisville garage. Line them up in front of the entrance. Keys inside. Tanks with enough fuel.

Don't try to be clever.
Don't be late.
Don't make us come find you.

Once we're done checking the cars, you might get what you want.

Or you might not.

Up to you.
Your target car list. Deliver them all to the drop-off point.
